description:
About APPS  FUNC SCM

Oracle Apps Func Supply Chain Management (SCM) basically integrates and automates all key supply chain activities starting from design, planning, and procurement to manufacturing and fulfillment. Supply chain management (SCM) is a systematic approach to manage the seamless flow of information, materials, and services from raw material suppliers through factories and warehouses to the end customer. Moreover, SCM involves seamless flow of material, information & finance in a network consisting of customers, suppliers, manufacturers, retailers and distributors.

Prerequisites

  • Graduates/Post Graduates are eligible.
  • Any funcational background consultants are eligible to learn Oracle Apps SCM Online Training.
